'''Teebo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tree/Legends|tree]] [[Deity/Legends|spirit]] of the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who, according to Ewok legends, convinced the legendary Ewok [[Machook (legend)|Machook]] not to harm the [[Forest/Legends|forests]]. Ewoks came to name their [[Wokling/Legends|children]] after the spirit.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Teebo was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' which was written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]].<ref name="GCG" />
